label: Add the switch of the module of the honeypot
summary: Adds column "honeypot" to "Modules" when it does not have it

execute.description: add the column, on for the guilds that are there
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."Modules" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "honeypot" bool NOT NULL DEFAULT true

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'Modules' AND column_name = 'honeypot') AS "result"
